correctness.rationale: Decomposition into 20 edge-disjoint local triangles gives a sharp global bound and exact field-dependent local minimizers. At zero field, the exact 2^20-term inclusion-exclusion identity counts every admissible labelling. Independent DFS on the canonical generalized Petersen labeling agrees on all 31 coefficients; a separate exhaustive matching recursion agrees on all 11 saturation coefficients. Explicit isomorphism between labelings is checked. These finite calculations prove precisely the stated finite claim and do not justify infinite or dynamical extrapolations.

value.rationale: The icosidodecahedron is a natural 30-spin spherical kagome nanomagnet. Its complete zero-field magnetization-resolved degeneracy and saturation-field matching total are natural exact invariants with physical interpretation in finite-cluster entropy and magnetization. The 3,251,250-state NAE manifold is not implied by the known 36-state perfect-matching plateau. The result is motivated by a sharp change in entropy under infinitesimal field, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
